description: WRITE tool — stop tracking one keyword/app pair in the caller's Sonar workspace. Identify the pair by its tracked-keyword id (from sonar_app_keywords). Equivalent to sonar_untrack_keywords with a single id; that tool removes several (or all) of an app's keywords in one call. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

tracked_keyword_id.description: The tracked-keyword UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_app_keywords. NOT the keyword_id.

name: sonar_delete_tracked_keyword
title: Delete Tracked Keyword
